Overview

Hervey Bay is a city in Queensland with a population of 60,441. Queensland’s whale watching capital with calm waters, Fraser Island access, and a relaxed coastal lifestyle. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
